unavailable: Automatic evaluation isn't available on your account yet. We saved your system and will let you know when you can check the connection.
role_not_found: We could not access your account with the read-only role. Check that the role exists and that the external identifier matches.
account_mismatch: The access you configured belongs to a different account than the one you declared. Check the account identifier.
credentials_invalid: The credentials are not valid or have been disabled. Check them and try again.
federation_rejected: Google Cloud did not accept Monkey's access. Check that you ran the setup command in that project and that the project number is its own.
regions_missing: You have not declared which regions to assess yet. Choose at least one.
not_configured: This system does not have its connection configured yet.
provider_not_supported: This platform isn't available to connect yet.
method_not_supported_by_runner: This connection type is assessed a different way and not from here.
method_not_applicable: That connection type is not available for this system.
agent_not_found: We could not find the probe for this server. Generate the install command again and run it once more.
agent_no_scan_yet: The probe on this server has not delivered its first assessment yet. Wait a few minutes and try again.
agent_disconnected: The probe on this server is not connected. Check that the server is on and can reach the internet, then try again.
agent_enroll_failed: We could not prepare the installation on this server. Try again in a few minutes; if it keeps happening, contact us.
agent_group_mismatch: The probe on this server does not belong to your company, so we did not save its results. Contact us.
probe_unreachable: We could not reach the probe right now. Try again in a few minutes; if it keeps happening, contact us.
probe_unauthorized: We could not authenticate to read the probe. Contact us.

access_keys.less_secure: Access keys are long-lived and less secure than a role. Use them only if you cannot create the role.
access_keys.step_1: In IAM, create a read-only user with the SecurityAudit and ViewOnlyAccess policies.
access_keys.step_2: Generate an access key for that user and paste it here. It is not shown again.

aws_role.step_1: Download the template and create it in your AWS account: CloudFormation → Create stack → With new resources → Upload a template file.
aws_role.step_2: When AWS asks for the parameters, paste the external identifier and the Monkey identity shown here.
aws_role.step_3: Tick the box acknowledging that AWS will create an IAM role and create the stack.
aws_role.step_4: When it finishes, copy the “RoleArn” value from the Outputs tab and paste it into this form.

gcp_federation.step_1: Open Cloud Shell in the Google Cloud console, in the project you want to connect.
gcp_federation.step_2: Copy the setup command and paste it into Cloud Shell. It creates read-only access for Monkey in that project; you do not hand over any key.
gcp_federation.step_3: When it finishes, the command prints the project number. Copy it and paste it into this form.

agent.step_1: Sign in to the server with an administrator account (on Windows, open PowerShell as administrator; on Linux, use a terminal with sudo).
agent.step_2: Copy the install command we show you and run it. It installs a lightweight Monkey program: we don't ask for passwords and no inbound ports are opened on your server.
agent.step_3: If your network restricts outbound connections, allow the one we list next to the command.
agent.step_4: Wait a few minutes. When the program connects, this server's status changes to “Connected”.

permission_denied: The user does not have enough permissions for automatic evaluation.
